harness: LocalPilot packaged Core HTTP, full permissions, standard profile, isolated case workspaces; not an OS security sandbox
prompt: Adapted offline SRE instructions. Only evidence in the case workspace may be used. No reference labels are supplied.
grader: Separate OpenAI gpt-5.5 medium entity normalization; deterministic alias-group precision at full recall. Inference failures retained.
scoring: 0 if any target alias-group is missed; otherwise TP/(TP+FP). All planned cases included, failures/errors score 0.
comparison: Not an official AA leaderboard result: public 40 of 59 scenarios, one repeat instead of three, LocalPilot tools/prompt/budgets instead of Stirrup.
storage: Reference labels removed from disk before agents run. Original inputs downloaded at immutable revision, content verified, discarded after case receipts and outputs are saved.
